info.title: How You Hear
info.subtitle: The path a sound travels, from air to meaning

rows.title: Outer ear
rows.desc: Funnels sound and locates where it came from

rows.title: Eardrum
rows.desc: Vibrates when sound waves reach it

rows.title: Middle-ear bones
rows.desc: Amplify motion and pass it inward

rows.title: Cochlea
rows.desc: Hair cells convert motion to nerve signals

rows.title: Auditory brain
rows.desc: Turns signals into speech and meaning
